changelog:
- Initial release of the local-skills-router skill.
- Provides a unified local routing layer for selecting the most appropriate downstream skill when requests may match multiple similar skills.
- Targets high-overlap skill clusters including ACP/ACPX harness, Lark, WeChat/Official Accounts, Xiaohongshu, and OpenCLI.
- Includes detailed routing tables and rules for each major skill cluster and overlap handling principles.
- Maintains local routing knowledge without modifying upstream skill definitions.
summary: 本地总路由技能。用于技能很多、请求可能命中多个相近 skill、或当前 agent 需要先判断“该读哪个 skill”时统一分流。先选下游 skill，再读取对应 SKILL.md。重点覆盖 ACP/ACPX harness、Lark、微信/公众号、小红书、OpenCLI 等高重叠技能簇。
